Power Apps.description: Row summaries now give you fast, AI-driven context for every record, right in your forms and grids. Set security roles to decide who can view each summary, so you control access and keep data secure. With expanded support for US Government clouds, more organizations can benefit from quick insights. See Microsoft-shipped summaries in grid views for the first time, making it easier to scan and act on important information. These improvements help you work efficiently and securely across all enviro

Power Apps.feature_name: Use streamlined header and navigation for better view
Power Apps.enabled_for: Users by admins, makers, or analysts
Power Apps.description: The refreshed header and navigation experience provides a cleaner, more efficient layout across the app shell, forms, and views. These updates help you work efficiently by increasing your working area on forms and views, reducing the time you spend navigating pages, and aligning the experience with the latest Microsoft 365 design patterns.

items.title: Outlook: Language support for Summarize in Classic Outlook
items.description: When the content language and the Outlook language do not match, you will be able to select a different language to view summarize Copilot responses.

items.title: Outlook: Microsoft Purview Label Inheritance from Email Attachments
items.description: When composing an email in Outlook for Mac, Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels can be automatically applied or recommended based on the sensitivity labels of attached files. This helps users consistently protect sensitive information, reduces manual labeling effort, and supports organizational compliance requirements by aligning email protection with the sensitivity of attached content.

items.title: Outlook: Purview Label Inheritance from Email Attachment for iOS and Android
items.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview sensitivity label inheritance from attachments. When users attach files with sensitivity labels, Outlook can automatically apply or recommend an email sensitivity label based on organizational policy settings. This helps organizations maintain consistent data classification and protection while reducing manual labeling effort.

items.title: OneDrive: Anchored comments in the PDF viewer
items.description: Microsoft is adding anchored comments to the PDF viewer in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web. Users can attach a comment to a specific spot on a page, to selected text, and collaborate through replies and @mentions — bringing PDF review to parity with commenting in Office documents. This feature will be on by default and requires no admin action.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call recaps in Queues app
items.description: Spend less time catching up on call recordings to resolve customer issues faster. For recorded call queue calls, the Queues app now supports intelligent call recaps for recorded calls that includes AI-generated summary notes, key discussion points, and follow-up actions. Navigate to the call record in the Queues app and select the Recap tab to access.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling per-policy coverage report
items.description: For each enforced auto-labeling policy, admins can view how files processed during enforcement correlate to the latest simulation run. The per-policy coverage report shows volumes of files that have been labeled or are not yet labeled, and whether those files were included in the last simulation snapshot. This helps admins understand enforcement progress for a specific policy against the data state captured during simulation, while also identifying files that were not found in the simulation sna

items.title: OneDrive: Uninstall OneDrive Photos without affecting file sync
items.description: OneDrive is giving people more control over their Windows experience by allowing them to uninstall the OneDrive Photos experience independently. Removing the Photos experience does not uninstall the OneDrive app, interrupt file sync, or delete photos and files. This provides a clear removal option for people who prefer to manage their photos with another app.

items.title: OneDrive: Manage access to the OneDrive Photos Desktop experience
items.description: OneDrive is adding administrative controls for the Photos experience on Windows. Organizations can manage whether users sign in with personal Microsoft accounts. These controls help IT teams align OneDrive Photos with their access, data governance, and device-management requirements.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: SQL server Support in Microsoft Copilot Studio
items.description: The Azure SQL Knowledge Source capability extends the range of enterprise data sources that makers can leverage when building agents in Copilot Studio. This enables organizations to bring business-critical information stored in Azure SQL into their agent experiences using the same knowledge-centric approach that customers already use across other supported knowledge sources. Azure SQL knowledge support represents another step toward a unified knowledge platform strategy, where customers can conn

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator Can Join Channel Meetings
items.description: Facilitator can now join meetings set up in Teams channels. Facilitator helps participants run more effective meetings through the ability to take live notes, manage the agenda, answer questions, and capture tasks.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Use Copilot Chat after a call in Queues app
items.description: After a recorded call is completed, use Copilot in the Queues app to quickly catch up on key details, uncover insights, and resolve customer issues faster without having to manually search through a transcript or listen back to a recording. Navigate to the unified call history in the Queues app, select the recorded call record, and launch the Copilot Chat sidecar from within the Recap tab. You can then ask Copilot to generate a summary or answer questions about specific details related to the ca

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Clearer text highlighting in dark mode and high contrast mode
items.description: We've improved how highlighted text looks when composing messages in dark mode and high contrast mode, giving you a more consistent editing experience.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Enhanced Security Mode Plus
items.description: Enhanced Security Mode Plus adds optional, admin-configurable protections on top of Enhanced Security Mode to further reduce browser attack surface. Admins can configure preset or custom modes to restrict selected network protocols and compression behavior, hardware-access web APIs, WebGL, and external protocol launches when Enhanced Security Mode is enabled.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Create and customize PBI reports
items.description: We are introducing a new feature for leaders and analysts of Viva Insights, where they can view a Power BI report, and edit time range, filters, attributes and change visuals as per their organizations' needs. They can then save the report for viewing later.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Catalog – Migration tool in Unified Catalog to migrate classic glossary terms to Unified Catalog
items.description: Use the in-product migration tool in Unified Catalog to migrate classic glossary terms, associated term templates, and asset and column relationships to Unified Catalog. Updated Augut 7, 2026: We have decided not to move forward with this change. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enable customers to book appointments from a live chat widget on your website
items.description: The Microsoft Teams live chat widget lets customers engage in one to one conversations with your business directly from your website, and now also enables appointment scheduling. Updated August 7, 2026: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
items.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Badges in Profile Card in Teams
items.description: You can now see Awards and Certifications as badges on a user’s profile card, bringing a more consistent experience across Teams and Outlook.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Control access to Learning Activities and Teach
items.description:
IT administrators can manage access to Learning Activities and Teach from the Microsoft 365 admin center. Configure Learning Activities separately for educators and for students ages 13 and older and enable or disable Teach for educators to align AI experiences with your organization's policies and deployment readiness.

#Education

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Assign Different Content to Learning Groups in a Single Assignment
items.description:
Enable educators to assign different content (attachments, resources, instructions) to different Individual Groups within a single Assignment. Today teachers must create separate assignments to differentiate — one for advanced readers, another for struggling students, etc. This feature collapses that into one assignment with group-specific content mapping.
Key capabilities:
Map different content to different Individual Groups within one Assignment
Students only see content assigned to their grou

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Security for non-Microsoft connected apps
items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention and Information Protection Auto-labeling capabilities now extend to non-Microsoft connected apps (e.g., Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Amazon Web Services, and Cisco Webex). The conditions and actions supported for each of these applications vary.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced IntelliFrame with AI data channel for intelligent cameras
items.description: Teams Rooms on Windows users can now benefit from next generation IntelliFrame features on certified AI-capable cameras with on-device video processing. With IntelliFrame’s expanded AI data channel, participants experience faster active speaker framing, people recognition and labels, and more responsive meeting views—even when network conditions are limited. These capabilities are available with Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App
items.description: The new Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time. While this is the quicker, light-weight Notebooks experience, you can still find the fuller, workspace-forward experience in OneNote.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
items.description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Export Copilot metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
items.description: This enables users to export row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: Microsoft Places Support to GCCH and DoD
items.description: "Microsoft Places is an AI-powered workplace app for flexible work. Places helps organizations reimagine flexible work with AI, enables employees to connect more easily in person so that they can make the most of in-office days.

items.title: Outlook: Enhanced user interface updates for iPhone and iPad
items.description: People using Outlook for iOS on iPhone and iPad will see refreshed interface elements aligned with the latest Liquid Glass iOS visual experience, including modernized app chrome, navigation, and use of screen space. It will be enabled by default with no administrator action required.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Readiness in Microsoft Copilot Studio
items.description: Agent Readiness gives makers a real-time, always-visible health check for their Copilot Studio agents. A single "Review" indicator in the build experience surfaces anything blocking or at risk — from policy restrictions to missing evaluations — before it derails a publish. Blocked capabilities are grayed out up front with a clear reason, so makers never waste time configuring something that was never going to work.

items.title: Outlook: Import support for data files in Outlook
items.description: This feature adds support for importing PST files into Outlook for Mac.
